method_modules.paper_role: inject projected point features into language token stream

compact point-token aggregation with neighborhood routing

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage I: Text-First Interface Warmup
candidate_mechanisms.description: Establish projector-language coupling under mostly frozen backbone settings. The model learns to align text descriptions with the projector while keeping the point encoder and LLM frozen.

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage II: Rich Instruction Alignment
candidate_mechanisms.description: Expand from simple descriptions to richer instruction/dialog patterns while preserving projector continuity. Maintains the frozen backbone constraint but introduces complex conversational data.

candidate_mechanisms.name: Stage III: Point-Language Transfer
candidate_mechanisms.description: Use point-cloud token features and compact token aggregation to transfer prior alignment to 3D inputs. Unfreezes or partially unfreezes the point encoder to enable end-to-end 3D-language alignment.

candidate_distinguishing_mechanisms: A compact local-to-global aggregation path is used before point features are conditioned into the LLM.
Core novelty emphasis is stage design and modality-transfer strategy rather than replacing the base LLM backbone.
